idea-plugin.name: Competitive Problem Receiver
idea-plugin.description:
A powerful IDEA plugin that acts as a bridge for competitive programmers. It listens for incoming problem data sent by the popular Competitive Companion browser extension and automatically parses it. Seamlessly fetch, view, and manage your programming contest problems directly within your IDE without leaving your workflow.
一个强大的 IDEA 插件，作为算法竞赛选手的桥梁。它监听由流行的 Competitive Companion 浏览器扩展发送的题目数据并自动解析。无需离开工作流，即可在 IDE 中无缝获取、查看和管理你的编程竞赛题目
Thanks for ur using! If you find any bugs or have any suggestions, please feel free to open an issue on the GitHub repository:
感谢使用！如果您发现任何错误或有任何建议，请随时在 GitHub 仓库上打开一个 issue： https://github.com/Azathorpe/Competitive-Problem-Receiver

⚠️ Note: This plugin identifies languages by file extensions. Please configure your default language in Settings -> Tools -> Competitive Problem Receiver.

⚠️ 注意： 本插件通过文件后缀来识别语言。请在 设置 -> 工具 -> Competitive Problem Receiver 中设置您的默认语言。初始默认语言为 Java。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.2 更新 / What's Changed

中文版:
  • 🐧 Linux 修复: 修复了在Linux系统上不能运行的Bug
  • 🥺 Kotlin 适配: 增加了对Kotlin的适配(我不会说是因为我想用)
  • ➕ 手动添加样例: 增加了对非从浏览器传入的题目进行添加样例的功能
  • 🏷️ 更名: 从 Competitive Companion on IDEA (cci) 改名为 Competitive Problem Receiver (cpr)
English Version:
  • 🐧 Linux Support: Fixed a critical bug that caused the plugin to crash on Linux systems.
  • 🥺 Kotlin Support: Added Kotlin adaptation... (I won't say it's because I wanted to use it myself, but that's definitely part of it!)
  • ➕ Manual Test Cases: You can now manually add sample inputs/outputs for problems that weren't sent from the browser.
  • 🏷️ Rebranding: Renamed from "Competitive Companion on IDEA (cci)" to "Competitive Problem Receiver (cpr)".

v1.1 更新

  • 🛠 Java, C/C++ 的编译运行
  • 🐍 Python 的运行
  • 📝 样例的添加和 Judge
  • 🎨 更好看的提交界面
  • 🐞 修改了上个版本的很多BUG
